mapper.select: SELECT h.HOSP_CD AS hospcd, h.HOSP_NM AS hospnm, h.JOIN_DT AS joindt FROM TBL_HOSP_MST h WHERE h.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} LIMIT 1

SELECT cm.DATE_YM AS ym , COUNT(*) AS bills , COUNT(DISTINCT mm.PAT_ID) AS pats , COALESCE(SUM(mm.ADM_DAYS),0) AS admdays , COALESCE(SUM(mm.TOT_AMT - CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = mm.BILL_SEQ AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') THEN FN_CLAIM_TAMT(mm.HOSP_CD,mm.CLAIM_NO,mm.BILL_SEQ,1) + FN_CLAIM_TAMT(mm.HOSP_CD,mm.CLAIM_NO,mm.BILL_SEQ,4) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totamt , COALESCE(SUM(mm.CLAIM_AMT - CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = mm.BILL_SEQ AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') THEN FN_CLAIM_TAMT(mm.HOSP_CD,mm.CLAIM_NO,mm.BILL_SEQ,3) + FN_CLAIM_TAMT(mm.HOSP_CD,mm.CLAIM_NO,mm.BILL_SEQ,6) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS claimamt , COALESCE(SUM(mm.SELF_AMT),0) AS selfamt FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE mm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tsm.ROW_NO) FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST tsm WHERE tsm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND tsm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO AND tsm.BILL_SEQ = mm.BILL_SEQ AND tsm.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JINORD_MST jsm WHERE jsm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND jsm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO AND jsm.BILL_SEQ = mm.BILL_SEQ AND jsm.ITEM_NO <> 'L') GROUP BY cm.DATE_YM ORDER BY cm.DATE_YM

SELECT cm.DATE_YM AS ym, cm.INSUR_TYPE AS insurtype , COALESCE(SUM(mm.TOT_AMT - CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = mm.BILL_SEQ AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') THEN FN_CLAIM_TAMT(mm.HOSP_CD,mm.CLAIM_NO,mm.BILL_SEQ,1) + FN_CLAIM_TAMT(mm.HOSP_CD,mm.CLAIM_NO,mm.BILL_SEQ,4) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totamt , COUNT(DISTINCT mm.PAT_ID) AS pats FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE mm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tsm.ROW_NO) FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST tsm WHERE tsm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND tsm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO AND tsm.BILL_SEQ = mm.BILL_SEQ AND tsm.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JINORD_MST jsm WHERE jsm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND jsm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO AND jsm.BILL_SEQ = mm.BILL_SEQ AND jsm.ITEM_NO <> 'L') GROUP BY cm.DATE_YM, cm.INSUR_TYPE ORDER BY cm.DATE_YM, cm.INSUR_TYPE

SELECT LEFT(p.MED_START,6) AS ym , LEFT(COALESCE(p.PAT_CLASS,'E'),1) AS cls , COUNT(DISTINCT p.PAT_ID) AS pats FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST p WHERE p.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND p.MED_START BETWEEN CONCAT(#{fromYm},'01') AND CONCAT(#{toYm},'31') GROUP BY LEFT(p.MED_START,6), LEFT(COALESCE(p.PAT_CLASS,'E'),1) ORDER BY ym, cls

SELECT x.ym , SUM(x.inflag) AS incnt , SUM(x.outflag) AS outcnt , ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN x.outflag = 1 THEN x.staydays END), 1) AS avgstay FROM ( SELECT a.jm, a.ipdt, a.twdt, m.ym , CASE WHEN a.ipdt LIKE CONCAT(m.ym,'%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inflag , CASE WHEN a.twdt LIKE CONCAT(m.ym,'%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS outflag , CASE WHEN a.twdt <> '' AND LENGTH(a.ipdt) = 8 AND LENGTH(a.twdt) = 8 THEN DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(a.twdt,'%Y%m%d'), STR_TO_DATE(a.ipdt,'%Y%m%d')) + 1 END AS staydays FROM (SELECT LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) AS jm , REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt , MAX(COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.TEWONDT,'-',''),'/',''),'')) AS twdt FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO t WHERE t.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND t.JOBYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6), REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','')) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT JOBYYMM AS ym FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND JOBYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm}) m ON (a.ipdt LIKE CONCAT(m.ym,'%') OR a.twdt LIKE CONCAT(m.ym,'%')) ) x WHERE x.inflag = 1 OR x.outflag = 1 GROUP BY x.ym ORDER BY x.ym
SELECT JOBYYMM AS ym, SUM(WEIGVAL) AS score FROM TBL_PAT_INDI WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND JOBYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY JOBYYMM ORDER BY JOBYYMM

WITH bl AS ( SELECT mm.HOSP_CD, mm.CLAIM_NO, mm.BILL_SEQ, mm.PAT_ID, mm.TOT_AMT, mm.ADM_DAYS, cm.DATE_YM AS ym FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} ), sp AS ( SELECT s.HOSP_CD, s.CLAIM_NO, s.BILL_SEQ, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ROW_NO) AS spn FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s JOIN bl ON bl.HOSP_CD = s.HOSP_CD AND bl.CLAIM_NO = s.CLAIM_NO AND bl.BILL_SEQ = s.BILL_SEQ WHERE s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008' GROUP BY s.HOSP_CD, s.CLAIM_NO, s.BILL_SEQ ), jsk AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.HOSP_CD, s.CLAIM_NO, s.BILL_SEQ, s.ROW_NO FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s JOIN sp ON sp.HOSP_CD = s.HOSP_CD AND sp.CLAIM_NO = s.CLAIM_NO AND sp.BILL_SEQ = s.BILL_SEQ WHERE s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008' ), jsa AS ( SELECT j.HOSP_CD, j.CLAIM_NO, j.BILL_SEQ, SUM(j.AMOUNT) AS jsamt FROM TBL_JINORD_MST j JOIN jsk ON jsk.HOSP_CD = j.HOSP_CD AND jsk.CLAIM_NO = j.CLAIM_NO AND jsk.BILL_SEQ = j.BILL_SEQ AND jsk.ROW_NO = j.ROW_NO WHERE IFNULL(j.DELYN,'') = '' GROUP BY j.HOSP_CD, j.CLAIM_NO, j.BILL_SEQ ), nl AS ( SELECT j.HOSP_CD, j.CLAIM_NO, j.BILL_SEQ, COUNT(*) AS nonl FROM TBL_JINORD_MST j JOIN sp ON sp.HOSP_CD = j.HOSP_CD AND sp.CLAIM_NO = j.CLAIM_NO AND sp.BILL_SEQ = j.BILL_SEQ WHERE j.ITEM_NO <> 'L' GROUP BY j.HOSP_CD, j.CLAIM_NO, j.BILL_SEQ ), kb AS ( SELECT sp.HOSP_CD, sp.CLAIM_NO, sp.BILL_SEQ FROM sp LEFT JOIN nl ON nl.HOSP_CD = sp.HOSP_CD AND nl.CLAIM_NO = sp.CLAIM_NO AND nl.BILL_SEQ = sp.BILL_SEQ WHERE sp.spn = IFNULL(nl.nonl, 0) ) SELECT h.ym , COUNT(*) AS hosps , ROUND(AVG(h.tot),0) AS avgtot , ROUND(AVG(h.tot / NULLIF(h.days,0)),0) AS avgperday , ROUND(AVG(h.pats),0) AS avgpats FROM ( SELECT b.HOSP_CD, b.ym, SUM(b.TOT_AMT - IFNULL(jsa.jsamt,0)) AS tot, SUM(b.ADM_DAYS) AS days, COUNT(DISTINCT b.PAT_ID) AS pats FROM bl b LEFT JOIN jsa ON jsa.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND jsa.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND jsa.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb WHERE kb.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND kb.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND kb.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ) GROUP BY b.HOSP_CD, b.ym HAVING tot > 0 ) h GROUP BY h.ym ORDER BY h.ym

SELECT START_YY AS startyy, QTER_FLAG AS qterflag, PAT_COUNT AS patcount, DOC_COUNT AS doccount , NUR_COUNT AS nurcount, NUR_S_CNT AS nurscnt, PHAM_DAYS AS phamdays, GOAL_SCORE AS goalscore, HOSPGRADE AS hospgrade FROM TBL_GRADE_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY START_YY DESC, QTER_FLAG DESC, UPD_DTTM DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(cm.DATE_YM) FROM TBL_CHUNG_MST cm WHERE cm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(cm.DEL_YN,'') <> 'Y'
SELECT HOSP_CD AS hospcd, BED_CNT AS bedcnt, VAR_COST_DAY AS varcostday, NOTE AS note, UPD_DTTM AS upddttm, UPD_USER AS upduser FROM TBL_MIS_CFG WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_CFG (HOSP_CD, BED_CNT, VAR_COST_DAY, NOTE, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{bedCnt}, #{varCostDay}, #{note}, #{userId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE BED_CNT = VALUES(BED_CNT), VAR_COST_DAY = VALUES(VAR_COST_DAY), NOTE = VALUES(NOTE), UPD_USER = VALUES(UPD_USER)
mapper.select: SELECT c.HOSP_CD AS hospcd, c.CAT_CD AS catcd, c.CAT_NM AS catnm, c.CAT_GB AS catgb, c.SORT_NO AS sortno, c.USE_YN AS useyn , CASE WHEN c.HOSP_CD = '*' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS own FROM TBL_MIS_COST_CAT c WHERE c.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} OR (c.HOSP_CD = '*' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_MIS_COST_CAT o WHERE o.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND o.CAT_CD = c.CAT_CD)) ORDER BY c.CAT_GB, c.SORT_NO, c.CAT_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_COST_CAT (HOSP_CD, CAT_CD, CAT_NM, CAT_GB, SORT_NO, USE_YN, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{catCd}, #{catNm}, #{catGb}, #{sortNo}, #{useYn}, #{userId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CAT_NM = VALUES(CAT_NM), CAT_GB = VALUES(CAT_GB), SORT_NO = VALUES(SORT_NO), USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN), UPD_USER = VALUES(UPD_USER)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_MIS_COST_CAT WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND CAT_CD = #{catCd} AND HOSP_CD <> '*'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND CAT_CD = #{catCd}
SELECT CAT_CD AS catcd, AMT AS amt, MEMO AS memo, UPD_DTTM AS upddttm, UPD_USER AS upduser FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND YYYYMM = #{ym}
SELECT MAX(YYYYMM) FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND YYYYMM < #{ym}

SELECT m.YYYYMM AS ym , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.CAT_GB = 'R' THEN m.AMT ELSE 0 END),0) AS extraamt , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.CAT_GB,'C') = 'C' THEN m.AMT ELSE 0 END),0) AS costamt FROM TBL_MIS_COST m LEFT JOIN TBL_MIS_COST_CAT c ON c.CAT_CD = m.CAT_CD AND c.HOSP_CD = (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_MIS_COST_CAT o WHERE o.HOSP_CD = m.HOSP_CD AND o.CAT_CD = m.CAT_CD) THEN m.HOSP_CD ELSE '*' END) WHERE m.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND m.YYYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY m.YYYYMM ORDER BY m.YYYYMM
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND YYYYMM = #{ym}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_COST (HOSP_CD, YYYYMM, CAT_CD, AMT, MEMO, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{ym}, #{catCd}, #{amt}, #{memo}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_CHUNG_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND DATE_YM = #{ym} AND COALESCE(DEL_YN,'') <> 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(REG_DTTM) AS lastreg FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND JOBYYMM = #{ym}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PAT_ID) AS cnt, MAX(REG_DTTM) AS lastreg FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND MED_START LIKE CONCAT(#{ym},'%')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(UPD_DTTM) AS lastreg, SUM(WEIGVAL) AS score FROM TBL_PAT_INDI WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND JOBYYMM = #{ym}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_GRADE_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND START_YY = #{yy} AND QTER_FLAG = #{qt} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND YYYYMM = #{ym}

SELECT CATE_CODE AS catecode, ORDER_SEQ AS orderseq, WEVALUE_NM AS wevaluenm , START_INDI AS startindi, END_INDI AS endindi, STD_SCORE AS stdscore, WE_VALUE AS wevalue FROM TBL_WEVALUE_MST WHERE CATE_CODE IN ('01','02','03') AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND #{today} BETWEEN START_DT AND END_DT ORDER BY CATE_CODE, START_INDI

SELECT LEAD_SEQ AS leadseq, PAT_NM AS patnm, BIRTH6 AS birth6, GENDER AS gender, GUARD_NM AS guardnm, GUARD_REL AS guardrel, TEL AS tel , CONTACT_DT AS contactdt, CHANNEL AS channel, COND_MEMO AS condmemo, STAGE AS stage, PLAN_DT AS plandt, NEXT_DT AS nextdt, NEXT_MEMO AS nextmemo , ADMIT_DT AS admitdt, DISCH_DT AS dischdt, MATCH_YN AS matchyn, CLOSE_RSN AS closersn, UPD_DTTM AS upddttm, UPD_USER AS upduser FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND (STAGE <> '90' OR UPD_DTTM >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)) ORDER BY STAGE, COALESCE(NEXT_DT, '99999999'), CONTACT_DT DESC, LEAD_SEQ DESC

SELECT LEAD_SEQ AS leadseq, PAT_NM AS patnm, BIRTH6 AS birth6, STAGE AS stage, ADMIT_DT AS admitdt, DISCH_DT AS dischdt, MATCH_YN AS matchyn FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_LEAD (HOSP_CD, PAT_NM, BIRTH6, GENDER, GUARD_NM, GUARD_REL, TEL, CONTACT_DT, CHANNEL, COND_MEMO, STAGE, PLAN_DT, NEXT_DT, NEXT_MEMO, ADMIT_DT, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{patNm}, #{birth6}, #{gender}, #{guardNm}, #{guardRel}, #{tel}, #{contactDt}, #{channel}, #{condMemo}, #{stage}, #{planDt}, #{nextDt}, #{nextMemo}, #{admitDt}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_MIS_LEAD SET STAGE = #{stage}, CLOSE_RSN = #{closeRsn}, UPD_USER = #{userId} WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq}

UPDATE TBL_MIS_LEAD SET STAGE = CASE WHEN STAGE < #{stage} THEN #{stage} ELSE STAGE END , ADMIT_DT = CASE WHEN COALESCE(ADMIT_DT,'') = '' THEN #{admitDt} ELSE ADMIT_DT END /* 빈 글자('')로 저장된 입원일도 채운다 — COALESCE 는 '' 를 값으로 본다(실측) */ , DISCH_DT = CASE WHEN #{dischDt} <> '' THEN #{dischDt} ELSE DISCH_DT END , MATCH_YN = 'Y' WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq}
UPDATE TBL_MIS_LEAD SET USE_YN = 'N', UPD_USER = #{userId} WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT l.LEAD_SEQ AS leadseq , REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt , MAX(COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.TEWONDT,'-',''),'/',''),'')) AS twdt FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD l JOIN TBL_IPWON_INFO t ON t.HOSP_CD = l.HOSP_CD AND LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) = l.BIRTH6 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(t.PATNAME,'[0-9]','') = l.PAT_NM AND REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') >= l.CONTACT_DT WHERE l.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND l.USE_YN = 'Y' AND l.STAGE IN ('10','20','30','40','50') /* 50(퇴원 후)도 다시 본다 — 입원일이 비어 있던 줄을 채우기 위해(멱등) */ AND COALESCE(l.BIRTH6,'') <> '' GROUP BY l.LEAD_SEQ, REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') ORDER BY l.LEAD_SEQ, ipdt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_LEAD_LOG (LEAD_SEQ, HOSP_CD, LOG_DT, STAGE, MEMO, REG_USER) VALUES (#{leadSeq}, #{hospCd}, #{logDt}, #{stage}, #{memo}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_SEQ AS logseq, LOG_DT AS logdt, STAGE AS stage, MEMO AS memo, REG_USER AS reguser, REG_DTTM AS regdttm FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD_LOG WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq} ORDER BY LOG_SEQ DESC

SELECT CHANNEL AS channel, COUNT(*) AS leads , SUM(CASE WHEN STAGE IN ('40','50') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS admits FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND CONTACT_DT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt} GROUP BY CHANNEL

SELECT a.jm AS birth6, a.nm AS patnm, a.ipdt, a.twdt , DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(a.twdt,'%Y%m%d'), STR_TO_DATE(a.ipdt,'%Y%m%d')) + 1 AS staydays , f.DONE_YN AS doneyn, f.DONE_DT AS donedt, f.RESULT_CD AS resultcd, f.MEMO AS memo , c.gnm AS guardnm, c.grel AS guardrel, c.gtel AS guardtel, c.tel AS tel , (SELECT MIN(REPLACE(REPLACE(r.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','')) FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO r WHERE r.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEFT(r.JUMINNO,6) = a.jm AND REGEXP_REPLACE(r.PATNAME,'[0-9]','') = a.nm AND REPLACE(REPLACE(r.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') > a.twdt) AS readmitdt FROM (SELECT LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) AS jm, REGEXP_REPLACE(t.PATNAME,'[0-9]','') AS nm , REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt , MAX(COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.TEWONDT,'-',''),'/',''),'')) AS twdt FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO t WHERE t.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND t.JOBYYMM >= #{fromYm} GROUP BY LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6), REGEXP_REPLACE(t.PATNAME,'[0-9]',''), REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') HAVING twdt BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt}) a LEFT JOIN TBL_MIS_FOLLOW f ON f.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND f.BIRTH6 = a.jm AND f.IPWON_DT = a.ipdt AND f.TEWON_DT = a.twdt
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ct.BIRTH6 AS jm, REGEXP_REPLACE(ct.PAT_NM,'[0-9]','') AS nm , MAX(NULLIF(ct.GUARD_NM,'')) AS gnm, MAX(NULLIF(ct.GUARD_REL,'')) AS grel, MAX(NULLIF(ct.GUARD_TEL,'')) AS gtel, MAX(NULLIF(ct.TEL,'')) AS tel FROM TBL_MIS_EMR_CONTACT ct WHERE ct.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(ct.BIRTH6,'') <> '' GROUP BY ct.BIRTH6, REGEXP_REPLACE(ct.PAT_NM,'[0-9]','')) c ON c.jm = a.jm AND c.nm = a.nm ORDER BY a.twdt DESC, a.nm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_FOLLOW (HOSP_CD, BIRTH6, IPWON_DT, TEWON_DT, DONE_YN, DONE_DT, RESULT_CD, MEMO, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{birth6}, #{ipwonDt}, #{tewonDt}, #{doneYn}, #{doneDt}, #{resultCd}, #{memo}, #{userId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DONE_YN = VALUES(DONE_YN), DONE_DT = VALUES(DONE_DT), RESULT_CD = VALUES(RESULT_CD), MEMO = VALUES(MEMO), UPD_USER = VALUES(UPD_USER)
mapper.select: SELECT NOTI_SEQ AS notiseq, NAME AS name, ROLE_NM AS rolenm, EMAIL AS email, TEL AS tel, MAIL_YN AS mailyn, SMS_YN AS smsyn , AUTO_GB AS autogb, MIN_LEVEL AS minlevel, USE_YN AS useyn, UPD_DTTM AS upddttm FROM TBL_MIS_NOTI_USER WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} ORDER BY USE_YN DESC, NOTI_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_NOTI_USER (HOSP_CD, NAME, ROLE_NM, EMAIL, TEL, MAIL_YN, SMS_YN, AUTO_GB, MIN_LEVEL, USE_YN, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{name}, #{roleNm}, #{email}, #{tel}, #{mailYn}, #{smsYn}, #{autoGb}, #{minLevel}, #{useYn}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_MIS_NOTI_USER WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND NOTI_SEQ = #{notiSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NM AS name, COALESCE(EMAIL,'') AS email, COALESCE(USER_TEL,'') AS tel, MAIN_GU AS maingu FROM TBL_USER_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(ACTION_YN,'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(USE_YN,'Y') <> 'N' AND (COALESCE(EMAIL,'') <> '' OR COALESCE(USER_TEL,'') <> '') GROUP BY USER_NM, COALESCE(EMAIL,''), COALESCE(USER_TEL,''), MAIN_GU ORDER BY MAIN_GU, USER_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_NOTI_LOG (HOSP_CD, CHANNEL, TO_ADDR, TO_NAME, SUBJECT, BODY, RESULT, ERR_MSG, SENT_BY, LEVEL_CNT) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{channel}, #{toAddr}, #{toName}, #{subject}, #{body}, #{result}, #{errMsg}, #{sentBy}, #{levelCnt})
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_SEQ AS logseq, CHANNEL AS channel, TO_ADDR AS toaddr, TO_NAME AS toname, SUBJECT AS subject, RESULT AS result, ERR_MSG AS errmsg , SENT_BY AS sentby, LEVEL_CNT AS levelcnt, DATE_FORMAT(SENT_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS sentdttm FROM TBL_MIS_NOTI_LOG WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} ORDER BY LOG_SEQ DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT x.cls , COUNT(DISTINCT x.PAT_ID) AS pats , SUM(x.ADM_DAYS) AS admdays , ROUND(SUM(x.TOT_AMT) / SUM(x.ADM_DAYS)) AS perday , ROUND(SUM(x.SELF_AMT) / SUM(x.ADM_DAYS)) AS selfday , ROUND(SUM(x.CLAIM_AMT) / SUM(x.ADM_DAYS)) AS claimday FROM (SELECT mm.PAT_ID, mm.ADM_DAYS, mm.TOT_AMT, mm.SELF_AMT, mm.CLAIM_AMT , (SELECT LEFT(COALESCE(p.PAT_CLASS,'E'),1) FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST p WHERE p.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND p.PAT_ID = mm.PAT_ID AND LEFT(p.MED_START,6) = cm.DATE_YM ORDER BY p.MED_START DESC, p.DOC_DT DESC LIMIT 1) AS cls FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE mm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} AND mm.ADM_DAYS > 0) x WHERE x.cls IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x.cls ORDER BY x.cls

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hosps , SUM(CASE WHEN h.perday > my.perday THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 1 AS rankperday , SUM(CASE WHEN h.days > my.days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 1 AS rankdays , ROUND(AVG(h.perday)) AS avgperday , ROUND(AVG(h.days)) AS avgdays , ROUND(my.perday) AS myperday , my.days AS mydays FROM (SELECT cm.HOSP_CD, SUM(mm.TOT_AMT) / NULLIF(SUM(mm.ADM_DAYS),0) AS perday, SUM(mm.ADM_DAYS) AS days FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM = #{ym} GROUP BY cm.HOSP_CD HAVING SUM(mm.ADM_DAYS) > 0) h JOIN (SELECT SUM(mm.TOT_AMT) / NULLIF(SUM(mm.ADM_DAYS),0) AS perday, SUM(mm.ADM_DAYS) AS days FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE mm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM = #{ym}) my WHERE my.days > 0

mapper.sql: sm AS (SELECT TRIM(cm.CLAIM_NO) AS claimno , CASE cm.INSUR_TYPE WHEN '4' THEN 'HB' WHEN '1' THEN 'BH' WHEN '2' THEN 'BH' WHEN '7' THEN 'BO' WHEN '8' THEN 'JB' WHEN '9' THEN 'SJ' ELSE CONCAT('T', COALESCE(cm.INSUR_TYPE,'')) END AS jong , CASE WHEN cm.INSUR_TYPE = '4' THEN '' WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(mm.INSUR_CODE,''),'[^0-9A-Za-z]','') REGEXP '^0*$' THEN '' ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(mm.INSUR_CODE,'[^0-9A-Za-z]','') END AS ass , mm.TOT_AMT AS totamt, mm.CLAIM_AMT AS claimamt, mm.PAT_ID AS patid FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE mm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM = #{ym})

SELECT k2.* , CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(k2.CLAIM_NO),'') <> '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sm WHERE sm.claimno = TRIM(k2.CLAIM_NO) AND (k2.cass = '' OR sm.ass = k2.cass)) THEN 'CLAIM' WHEN k2.cass <> '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sm WHERE sm.ass = k2.cass AND (k2.cjong IS NULL OR sm.jong = k2.cjong)) THEN 'ASS' WHEN k2.cass = '' AND k2.cjong IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sm WHERE sm.jong = k2.cjong) THEN 'JONG' ELSE '' END AS matchgb FROM (SELECT k1.*, CASE WHEN k1.cjong = 'HB' OR k1.cass0 REGEXP '^0*$' THEN '' ELSE k1.cass0 END AS cass FROM (SELECT c.* , REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(c.ASS_CD,''),'[^0-9A-Za-z]','') AS cass0 , CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.CUT_GB,'') REGEXP '불능' THEN 'N' WHEN COALESCE(c.CUT_GB,'') REGEXP '조정|환수|공제' THEN 'A' ELSE 'D' END AS gb , COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(sm.jong) FROM sm WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(c.CLAIM_NO),'') <> '' AND sm.claimno = TRIM(c.CLAIM_NO)), CASE WHEN c.JONG_NM REGEXP '건강|건보|공단' THEN 'HB' WHEN c.JONG_NM REGEXP '의료급여|보호' THEN 'BH' WHEN c.JONG_NM REGEXP '보훈' THEN 'BO' WHEN c.JONG_NM REGEXP '자동차|자보' THEN 'JB' WHEN c.JONG_NM REGEXP '산재' THEN 'SJ' END, (SELECT MIN(sm.jong) FROM sm WHERE sm.ass <> '' AND sm.ass = REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(c.ASS_CD,''),'[^0-9A-Za-z]','')) ) AS cjong FROM TBL_MIS_EMR_CUT c WHERE c.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND c.YYYYMM = #{ym}) k1) k2

WITH SELECT x.SEQ_NUM AS seq, x.CLAIM_NO AS claimno, x.RESULT_DT AS resultdt, x.JONG_NM AS jongnm, x.ASS_CD AS asscd, x.ASS_NM AS assnm, x.CUT_GB AS cutgb , x.INOUT_GB AS inoutgb, x.CUT_RSN_CD AS cutrsncd, x.CUT_RSN AS cutrsn, x.CLAIM_AMT AS claimamt, x.CUT_AMT AS cutamt, x.OBJ_GB AS objgb, x.MEMO AS memo , COALESCE(x.cjong,'') AS cjong, x.cass AS cass, x.gb AS gb, x.matchgb AS matchgb
, CASE x.matchgb WHEN 'CLAIM' THEN (SELECT SUM(sm.claimamt) FROM sm WHERE sm.claimno = TRIM(x.CLAIM_NO) AND (x.cass = '' OR sm.ass = x.cass)) WHEN 'ASS' THEN (SELECT SUM(sm.claimamt) FROM sm WHERE sm.ass = x.cass AND (x.cjong IS NULL OR sm.jong = x.cjong)) WHEN 'JONG' THEN (SELECT SUM(sm.claimamt) FROM sm WHERE sm.jong = x.cjong) END AS samclaimamt FROM () x ORDER BY x.SEQ_NUM LIMIT 3000

WITH , k AS () SELECT x.jong AS jong, x.ass AS ass, MAX(x.assnm) AS assnm , SUM(x.samcnt) AS samcnt, SUM(x.sampats) AS sampats, SUM(x.samclaim) AS samclaim , SUM(x.cutd) AS cutd, SUM(x.cutn) AS cutn, SUM(x.cuta) AS cuta, SUM(x.cutcnt) AS cutcnt FROM (SELECT sm.jong AS jong, sm.ass AS ass, NULL AS assnm, COUNT(*) AS samcnt, COUNT(DISTINCT sm.patid) AS sampats, COALESCE(SUM(sm.claimamt),0) AS samclaim , 0 AS cutd, 0 AS cutn, 0 AS cuta, 0 AS cutcnt FROM sm GROUP BY sm.jong, sm.ass UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN k.matchgb = '' THEN '?' ELSE COALESCE(k.cjong,'?') END, CASE WHEN k.matchgb = '' THEN '' ELSE k.cass END, NULLIF(TRIM(k.ASS_NM),'') , 0, 0, 0 , CASE WHEN k.gb = 'D' THEN COALESCE(k.CUT_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN k.gb = 'N' THEN COALESCE(k.CUT_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END , CASE WHEN k.gb = 'A' THEN COALESCE(k.CUT_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, 1 FROM k) x GROUP BY x.jong, x.ass ORDER BY FIELD(x.jong,'HB','BH','BO','JB','SJ','?'), x.ass

SELECT ip.chartno AS chartno, ip.patnm AS patnm, ip.birth6 AS birth6, ip.ipdt AS ipdt , 'IN' AS ipstatus, NULL AS outdt , DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), STR_TO_DATE(ip.ipdt,'%Y%m%d')) + 1 AS staydays , ct.tel AS tel, ct.guardnm AS guardnm , ld.stage AS stage, ld.leadseq AS leadseq , 0 AS pvcnt, NULL AS docdt, NULL AS patclass FROM (SELECT LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) AS birth6, REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt , MAX(t.CHARTNO) AS chartno, REGEXP_REPLACE(MAX(t.PATNAME),'[0-9]','') AS patnm , MAX(COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.TEWONDT,'-',''),'/',''),'')) AS twdt FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO t WHERE t.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}$' GROUP BY LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6), REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','')) ip LEFT JOIN (SELECT BIRTH6, PAT_NM, MAX(TEL) AS tel, MAX(GUARD_NM) AS guardnm FROM TBL_MIS_EMR_CONTACT WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY BIRTH6, PAT_NM) ct ON ct.BIRTH6 = ip.birth6 AND ct.PAT_NM = ip.patnm LEFT JOIN (SELECT BIRTH6, PAT_NM, MAX(LEAD_SEQ) AS leadseq, MAX(STAGE) AS stage FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY BIRTH6, PAT_NM) ld ON ld.BIRTH6 = ip.birth6 AND ld.PAT_NM = ip.patnm WHERE ip.twdt = '' AND ip.ipdt >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST v WHERE v.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEFT(v.PAT_ID,6) = ip.birth6 AND v.ADMIT_DT = ip.ipdt) ORDER BY ip.ipdt DESC LIMIT 1000

'' THEN NULL ELSE ip.twdt END AS outdt , CASE WHEN ip.birth6 IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ip.twdt = '' THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), STR_TO_DATE(a.ipdt,'%Y%m%d')) + 1 ELSE DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(ip.twdt,'%Y%m%d'), STR_TO_DATE(a.ipdt,'%Y%m%d')) + 1 END AS staydays , ct.tel AS tel, ct.guardnm AS guardnm , ld.stage AS stage, ld.leadseq AS leadseq , a.pvcnt AS pvcnt, a.docdt AS docdt, a.patclass AS patclass FROM (SELECT LEFT(v.PAT_ID,6) AS birth6, MAX(v.PAT_NM) AS patnm, v.ADMIT_DT AS ipdt , COUNT(*) AS pvcnt, MAX(v.DOC_DT) AS docdt , SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(v.PAT_CLASS ORDER BY v.DOC_DT DESC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS patclass , MAX(ip0.chartno) AS chartno FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST v LEFT JOIN (SELECT LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) AS birth6, REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt, MAX(t.CHARTNO) AS chartno FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO t WHERE t.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6), REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','')) ip0 ON ip0.birth6 = LEFT(v.PAT_ID,6) AND ip0.ipdt = v.ADMIT_DT WHERE v.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEFT(v.MED_START,6) = (SELECT MAX(LEFT(MED_START,6)) FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}) GROUP BY LEFT(v.PAT_ID,6), v.ADMIT_DT) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) AS birth6, REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt , MAX(COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.TEWONDT,'-',''),'/',''),'')) AS twdt FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO t WHERE t.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6), REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','')) ip ON ip.birth6 = a.birth6 AND ip.ipdt = a.ipdt LEFT JOIN (SELECT BIRTH6, PAT_NM, MAX(TEL) AS tel, MAX(GUARD_NM) AS guardnm FROM TBL_MIS_EMR_CONTACT WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY BIRTH6, PAT_NM) ct ON ct.BIRTH6 = a.birth6 AND ct.PAT_NM = a.patnm LEFT JOIN (SELECT BIRTH6, PAT_NM, MAX(LEAD_SEQ) AS leadseq, MAX(STAGE) AS stage FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY BIRTH6, PAT_NM) ld ON ld.BIRTH6 = a.birth6 AND ld.PAT_NM = a.patnm ORDER BY FIELD(ipstatus,'IN','NONE','OUT'), a.ipdt DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT s.EMP_NM AS empnm, s.JOB_NM AS jobnm, s.DEPT_NM AS deptnm, s.WORK_GB AS workgb , s.JOIN_DT AS joindt, s.RETIRE_DT AS retiredt FROM TBL_MIS_EMR_STAFF s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND s.YYYYMM = (SELECT MAX(YYYYMM) FROM TBL_MIS_EMR_STAFF WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}) AND s.JOB_NM LIKE '간호%' ORDER BY s.JOB_NM, s.DEPT_NM, s.EMP_NM LIMIT 300

mapper.select: SELECT j.ITEM_NO AS itemno, COALESCE(MAX(D.SUB_CODE_NM), CONCAT('항목 ', j.ITEM_NO)) AS itemnm, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.base_amt > 0 AND ( (b.PAY_TYPE = '1' AND j.ITEM_NO = 'L' AND j.CODE_TYPE IN ('1','8')) OR (b.PAY_TYPE <> '1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = j.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = j.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = j.BILL_SEQ AND s.ROW_NO = j.ROW_NO AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008'))) THEN COALESCE(b.CLAIM_AMT,0) * j.AMOUNT / bs.base_amt ELSE 0 END), 0), 0) AS amt, COALESCE(SUM(j.AMOUNT),0) AS ordamt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TBL_JINORD_MST j JOIN TBL_MYOUNG_MST b ON b.HOSP_CD = j.HOSP_CD AND b.CLAIM_NO = j.CLAIM_NO AND b.BILL_SEQ = j.BILL_SEQ JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST c ON c.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND c.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO JOIN (SELECT j2.HOSP_CD, j2.CLAIM_NO, j2.BILL_SEQ, SUM(j2.AMOUNT) AS base_amt FROM TBL_JINORD_MST j2 JOIN TBL_MYOUNG_MST b2 ON b2.HOSP_CD = j2.HOSP_CD AND b2.CLAIM_NO = j2.CLAIM_NO AND b2.BILL_SEQ = j2.BILL_SEQ WHERE j2.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(b2.DELYN,'') = '' AND ((b2.PAY_TYPE = '1' AND j2.ITEM_NO = 'L' AND j2.CODE_TYPE IN ('1','8')) OR (b2.PAY_TYPE <> '1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = j2.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = j2.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = j2.BILL_SEQ AND s.ROW_NO = j2.ROW_NO AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008'))) GROUP BY j2.HOSP_CD, j2.CLAIM_NO, j2.BILL_SEQ) bs ON bs.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND bs.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND bs.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ LEFT JOIN TBL_CODE_DTL D ON D.CODE_GB = 'YD' AND D.CODE_CD = 'ITEM_NO' AND D.SUB_CODE = TRIM(j.ITEM_NO) WHERE j.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND c.DATE_YM = #{ym} AND COALESCE(b.DELYN,'') = '' GROUP BY j.ITEM_NO ORDER BY amt DESC

SELECT base.med AS code , COALESCE(D.SUB_CODE_NM, '기타') AS nm , base.amt AS amt , base.cnt AS cnt FROM ( SELECT IFNULL(C.MED_FIELD, B.MED_TYPE) AS med , SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(B.MED_AMT2, 0), B.TOT_AMT, 0) + IFNULL(B.NON100_AMT,0) - FN_CLAIM_TAMT(B.HOSP_CD,B.CLAIM_NO,B.BILL_SEQ,1) - FN_CLAIM_TAMT(B.HOSP_CD,B.CLAIM_NO,B.BILL_SEQ,4)) AS amt , COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TBL_CHUNG_MST A JOIN TBL_MYOUNG_MST B ON A.CLAIM_NO = B.CLAIM_NO AND A.HOSP_CD = B.HOSP_CD LEFT JOIN TBL_DISEASE_MST C ON C.CLAIM_NO = B.CLAIM_NO AND C.HOSP_CD = B.HOSP_CD AND C.BILL_SEQ = B.BILL_SEQ AND C.DIAG_TYPE = '1' WHERE A.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND A.DATE_YM = #{ym} AND IFNULL(B.DELYN,'') <> 'Y' AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tsm.ROW_NO) FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST tsm WHERE tsm.HOSP_CD = B.HOSP_CD AND tsm.CLAIM_NO = B.CLAIM_NO AND tsm.BILL_SEQ = B.BILL_SEQ AND tsm.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JINORD_MST jsm WHERE jsm.HOSP_CD = B.HOSP_CD AND jsm.CLAIM_NO = B.CLAIM_NO AND jsm.BILL_SEQ = B.BILL_SEQ AND jsm.ITEM_NO <> 'L') GROUP BY IFNULL(C.MED_FIELD, B.MED_TYPE) ) base LEFT JOIN TBL_CODE_DTL D ON D.CODE_GB = 'Z' AND D.CODE_CD = 'MED_DEPT' AND D.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND D.SUB_CODE = base.med ORDER BY base.amt DESC

SELECT pd.grp AS code, COALESCE(MAX(Z.SUB_CODE_NM), '기타병명') AS nm, COUNT(*) AS bills, COALESCE(SUM(pd.totamt),0) AS amt, COUNT(DISTINCT pd.patid) AS pats FROM ( SELECT b.HOSP_CD, b.CLAIM_NO, b.BILL_SEQ, b.PAT_ID AS patid, b.TOT_AMT - CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') THEN FN_CLAIM_TAMT(b.HOSP_CD,b.CLAIM_NO,b.BILL_SEQ,1) + FN_CLAIM_TAMT(b.HOSP_CD,b.CLAIM_NO,b.BILL_SEQ,4) ELSE 0 END AS totamt, COALESCE((SELECT LEFT(d.DIAG_CODE,3) FROM TBL_DISEASE_MST d WHERE d.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND d.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND d.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ AND d.DIAG_TYPE = '1' LIMIT 1), 'ZZ') AS grp FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST b JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST c ON c.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND c.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO WHERE b.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(b.DELYN,'') = '' AND c.DATE_YM = #{ym} AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tsm.ROW_NO) FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST tsm WHERE tsm.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND tsm.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND tsm.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ AND tsm.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JINORD_MST jsm WHERE jsm.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND jsm.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND jsm.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ AND jsm.ITEM_NO <> 'L') ) pd LEFT JOIN TBL_CODE_DTL Z ON Z.CODE_GB = 'Z' AND Z.CODE_CD = 'DISEASE_TYPE' AND Z.SUB_CODE = pd.grp AND Z.ACTION_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY pd.grp ORDER BY amt DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT CASE WHEN c.TREAT_TYPE IN ('2','4','9','H','6') THEN 'O' ELSE 'I' END AS gb, COUNT(*) AS bills, COALESCE(SUM(b.TOT_AMT - CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') THEN FN_CLAIM_TAMT(b.HOSP_CD,b.CLAIM_NO,b.BILL_SEQ,1) + FN_CLAIM_TAMT(b.HOSP_CD,b.CLAIM_NO,b.BILL_SEQ,4) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amt FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST b JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST c ON c.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND c.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO WHERE b.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(b.DELYN,'') = '' AND c.DATE_YM = #{ym} AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tsm.ROW_NO) FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST tsm WHERE tsm.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND tsm.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND tsm.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ AND tsm.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_JINORD_MST jsm WHERE jsm.HOSP_CD = b.HOSP_CD AND jsm.CLAIM_NO = b.CLAIM_NO AND jsm.BILL_SEQ = b.BILL_SEQ AND jsm.ITEM_NO <> 'L') GROUP BY gb ORDER BY gb

SELECT CASE WHEN B.PAY_TYPE = '1' THEN 'FIXED' ELSE 'RATE' END AS kind, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = jj.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = jj.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = jj.BILL_SEQ AND s.ROW_NO = jj.ROW_NO AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') THEN jj.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalamt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN jj.ITEM_NO = 'L' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = jj.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = jj.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = jj.BILL_SEQ AND s.ROW_NO = jj.ROW_NO AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') THEN jj.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nonclaimamt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SPECODE_MST s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = jj.HOSP_CD AND s.CLAIM_NO = jj.CLAIM_NO AND s.BILL_SEQ = jj.BILL_SEQ AND s.ROW_NO = jj.ROW_NO AND s.SPEC_TYPE = 'JS008') THEN jj.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS entrustamt FROM TBL_JINORD_MST jj JOIN TBL_MYOUNG_MST B ON B.HOSP_CD = jj.HOSP_CD AND B.CLAIM_NO = jj.CLAIM_NO AND B.BILL_SEQ = jj.BILL_SEQ JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST A ON A.HOSP_CD = B.HOSP_CD AND A.CLAIM_NO = B.CLAIM_NO WHERE jj.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND jj.CODE_TYPE = '3' AND A.DATE_YM = #{ym} AND COALESCE(B.DELYN,'') <> 'Y' GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

SELECT REPLACE(p.PAY_DT,'-','') AS paydt, CASE WHEN p.INOUT_GB LIKE '%입%' THEN 'IP' WHEN p.INOUT_GB LIKE '%외%' THEN 'OP' ELSE 'ETC' END AS io, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.PAY_METHOD),''),'기타') AS pm, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(p.TOT_AMT),0) AS totamt, COALESCE(SUM(p.INS_AMT),0) AS insamt, COALESCE(SUM(p.SELF_AMT),0) AS selfamt, COALESCE(SUM(p.NONPAY_AMT),0) AS nonpayamt, COALESCE(SUM(p.PAID_AMT),0) AS paidamt, COALESCE(SUM(p.UNPAID_AMT),0) AS unpaidamt FROM TBL_MIS_EMR_PAY p WHERE p.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND REPLACE(p.PAY_DT,'-','') BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt} GROUP BY REPLACE(p.PAY_DT,'-',''), io, pm ORDER BY paydt
